label: LeafLimits
info:
Plant-specific limits for MicroHydros. Additive: it only reads validated readings and never changes the validation or storage flows.

The tab is imported DISABLED. Before enabling it, set the credential variables (Edit tab, Environment Variables): LEAFLIMITS_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
Disable the tab again to return to the original behaviour.

name: 1. Evaluate readings against the limits
info: Subscribes to the validated readings that the MQTT Validation flow publishes and classifies each one as ok, low or high. Nothing here changes the validation flow or the storage flow. Alerts are published on microhydros/v1/devices/{id}/limits/alert only when a state changes.

name: Evaluate against limits
2. Limits storage (retained MQTT message)
info: The limits of a device live as a retained message on microhydros/v1/devices/{id}/limits/config. This flow subscribes to it, so the limits come back after any restart without changing the Node-RED settings. Publish an empty retained message to clear a profile.

name: Store profile in memory
3. HTTP API for the LeafLimits app
info: Every route needs "Authorization: Bearer <token>" where the token is the tab variable LEAFLIMITS_TOKEN. GET/PUT /leaflimits/api/limits/:device, GET /leaflimits/api/status/:device, POST /leaflimits/api/suggest.

4. The LeafLimits web app
info: Serves the built Angular app from the folder in LEAFLIMITS_APP_DIR (default /data/leaflimits-app) at /leaflimits/. Copy the files there with: docker cp app-dist/. <node-red container>:/data/leaflimits-app/
